summary: Parked-on residential kerb, flat at the dip, but homes 16-21 m away.

best_section.where: Mid-block on the north side, between the two driveways, at the low point of the street

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing; mapped dwellings 16-21 m away on the north side and more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Quiet two-way street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, short block between two junctions.
drivers.convention: Cars park here nightly, so a van is less conspicuous, but neighbours are close.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
Steep elsewhere: about 6% mean, rises to the east end
sun_shade: Large tree canopy shades the kerb around 50-70 m; open sun elsewhere.
